items.docs:
This endpoint will list available assignments for a <<glossary:team member>>. Assigning a team member to another resource provides them access to that resource's loans and the ability to interact with those <<glossary:loan>>s.
Assignments are restricted by the team member's placement within the organization and possible setting configuration.
